description: Manage bzr branches to deploy files or software.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Absolute path of where the branch should be cloned to.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Path to bzr executable to use. If not supplied, the normal mechanism for resolving binary paths is used.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, any modified files in the working tree is discarded. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: SSH or HTTP protocol address of the parent branch.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: What version of the branch to clone. This can be the bzr revno or revid. Default: "head"

examples:
- name: Checkout
  community.general.bzr:
    name: bzr+ssh://foosball.example.org/path/to/branch
    dest: /srv/checkout
    version: 22
